atoms.label: Button
atoms.description: Triggers an action. Variants: default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link; sizes from xs to lg plus icon-only.

atoms.label: Badge
atoms.description: Small status or count label attached to other content.

atoms.label: Avatar
atoms.description: User or entity image with a text fallback (e.g. initials).

atoms.label: Aspect Ratio
atoms.description: Keeps media at a fixed width-to-height ratio as it resizes.

atoms.label: Checkbox
atoms.description: Binary or indeterminate choice, usually paired with a Label.

atoms.label: Radio Group
atoms.description: Single choice from a small set of mutually exclusive options.

atoms.label: Label
atoms.description: Accessible text label bound to a form control.

atoms.label: Input
atoms.description: Single-line text field.

atoms.label: Tag
atoms.description: Alias of Badge: keyword or category marker.

atoms.label: Chip
atoms.description: Alias of Badge: compact token for a selection or filter.

atoms.label: Spinner
atoms.description: Indeterminate loading indicator.

atoms.label: Progress Bar
atoms.description: Determinate progress of a task, from 0 to 100%.

atoms.label: Icon
atoms.description: Single glyph from the icon set. No shadcn component: shadcn uses lucide-react icons directly.

atoms.label: Keyboard Key
atoms.description: Displays a keyboard key or shortcut, e.g. Cmd + K.

atoms.label: Skeleton
atoms.description: Placeholder shape shown while content loads.

atoms.label: Select
atoms.description: Choose one value from a list shown in a popover.

atoms.label: Switch
atoms.description: On/off toggle for a setting that applies immediately.

atoms.label: Slider
atoms.description: Pick a value or range by dragging along a track.

atoms.label: Scroll
atoms.description: Scroll container with custom, consistently styled scrollbars.

atoms.label: Separator
atoms.description: Horizontal or vertical divider between content.

atoms.label: Link
atoms.description: Inline navigational text. No shadcn component: closest is Button's link variant.

molecules.label: Alert
molecules.description: Inline callout for important messages; default and destructive variants.

molecules.label: Tooltip
molecules.description: Short hint shown on hover or focus of a trigger.

molecules.label: Form Field
molecules.description: Label, control, description and error message composed as one field.

molecules.label: Search Bar
molecules.description: Search input with a leading icon and optional actions, composed from Input Group.

molecules.label: Breadcrumb
molecules.description: Hierarchical path to the current page, with links back up.

molecules.label: Bubble
molecules.description: Chat message bubble with optional reactions; can be grouped.

molecules.label: Carousel
molecules.description: Horizontally scrolling set of slides with previous/next controls.

molecules.label: Chat
molecules.description: A single chat message: avatar, header, content and footer.

molecules.label: Hover Card
molecules.description: Rich preview card shown when hovering a link or trigger.

molecules.label: Empty Placeholder
molecules.description: Empty-state message with optional icon and action.

molecules.label: Product Thumbnail
molecules.description: Product image with name and price. Custom composition, no shadcn source.

molecules.label: Popover
molecules.description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger, for rich interactive content.

molecules.label: Resizable Panel
molecules.description: Panels separated by draggable handles that resize them.

organisms.label: Accordion
organisms.description: Stacked sections that expand and collapse.

organisms.label: Dialog
organisms.description: Modal window over a dimmed backdrop that captures focus until dismissed.

organisms.label: File Upload
organisms.description: Drop zone or picker for selecting and uploading files. Custom composition, no shadcn source.

organisms.label: Attachment
organisms.description: File attachment card: media, title, description and actions; can be grouped.

organisms.label: Card
organisms.description: Container grouping related content: header, content and footer.

organisms.label: Code Block
organisms.description: Syntax-highlighted code with a copy action.

organisms.label: Collapse Menu
organisms.description: Navigation group that expands and collapses.

organisms.label: Chat Window
organisms.description: Scrolling message thread that stays pinned to the latest message.

organisms.label: Overlap Menu
organisms.description: Command palette: searchable list of actions, often opened with Cmd + K.

organisms.label: Overlay
organisms.description: Dimmed backdrop behind dialogs, sheets and drawers. shadcn has no standalone component; each renders its own overlay part.

organisms.label: Context Menu
organisms.description: Menu opened by right-click or long-press on an element.

organisms.label: Dropdown Menu
organisms.description: Menu of actions opened from a button.

organisms.label: Navigation Menu
organisms.description: Site navigation with dropdown panels of links.

organisms.label: Sidebar
organisms.description: Collapsible app sidebar for primary navigation.

organisms.label: User Profile Widget
organisms.description: Avatar, name and account actions. Custom composition, no shadcn source.

organisms.label: Data Table
organisms.description: Sortable, filterable, paginated table. A shadcn recipe on Table + TanStack Table.

organisms.label: Footer
organisms.description: Page footer with links and legal text. Custom composition, no shadcn source.

organisms.label: Modal
organisms.description: Alias of Dialog.

organisms.label: Drawer
organisms.description: Panel that slides in from the bottom edge, mobile-friendly.

organisms.label: Sheet
organisms.description: Panel that slides in from any screen edge, for secondary content.

organisms.label: Tabs
organisms.description: Switch between views that share the same space.

organisms.label: Trace
organisms.description: AI agent trace: chain-of-thought, tool calls, sources and tasks in collapsible rows.

organisms.label: Date Picker
organisms.description: Pick a date or range from a calendar in a popover. A shadcn recipe on Calendar + Popover.

organisms.label: Menu Bar
organisms.description: Desktop-style horizontal menu bar (File, Edit, View...).

organisms.label: Pagination
organisms.description: Navigate between pages of results.

organisms.label: Questionnaire
organisms.description: Multi-step question flow with choices, progress, and previous/next/skip/submit.

organisms.label: Snackbar
organisms.description: Alias of Toast.
